MICCAI 2026 · FLARE Challenge · Task 1 · team jehb4ik

PANTHER: PAN-cancer CT Segmentation with Two-tier Healthy-scan Ensemble Rejection

Segmentation that knows when to say no: a five-fold plain U-Net ensemble with two tiers of abstention on healthy scans, fold agreement and a Mahalanobis gate on the shape of the predicted mask. It runs inside the challenge limits of 60 s and 4 GB per scan.

Evgeniia Przhezdzetskaia, Vasilii Baranov, Mariia Khazova, Victor Gombolevskiy

How it works

The submitted pipeline has no extra classifier and no pseudo-labels. Everything that reduces false positives is either the ensemble itself or a five-number statistic of the mask.

TRAINING DATA

Per-source capping

From 17 575 labelled CT scans, large sources are capped and rare ones kept in full: 8762 scans from 28 source datasets. With identical training this subset beats the full set by +0.060 DSC, more than any architecture change we tried.

TIER 1

Fold agreement

Five nnU-Net folds are averaged before binarisation. When the folds disagree, the mean probability falls below 0.5 and the mask stays empty: 52 of 172 healthy scans come out empty, versus none for a single model.

TIER 2

Mahalanobis shape gate

Volume, number of components, largest-component volume and fraction, surface-to-volume ratio. Log-transformed and compared with their distribution on 172 healthy scans; a mask closer than τ = 7 is discarded. AUROC 0.974, no change on hidden validation.

Results

Accuracy on the hidden validation set, false positives on the healthy scans, and the timed run of the submitted container on the 50 public validation scans (RTX 3090, -m 28G, default --shm-size).

Code & weights

Training scripts, the Dataset500 manifest, the gate fit and the exact inference container are on GitHub; the five checkpoints are on HuggingFace.

GitHub repository Weights on HuggingFace 
pip install huggingface_hub
python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; snapshot_download('jehb4ik/PANTHER-FLARE2026', local_dir='docker/model')"
